    "summary": "The graph captures the core ignition-to-fire sequence, but it compresses an important documented escalation step and contains one evidence-format problem. The main logical improvement is to make Ev1 explicitly represent the initial oxidizer-bay fire and its spread to the flammable liquid storage area, which better matches the chosen Pool fire consequence.",

      "Ev1 is narrower than the downstream Pool fire consequence and does not explicitly include the documented spread to the flammable liquid storage area.",

      "H1 evidence is not strictly verbatim and does not follow the schema evidence rule."

      "reason": "This is the smallest change that restores the missing causal step without adding extra nodes. It aligns the node name with the documented escalation and makes the existing Ev1 -> H1 link more direct and defensible.",

      "severity": "medium",

      "current_state": "The report states, \"This case study examines a fire at the Environmental Quality Company (EQ) hazardous waste facility in Apex, North Carolina.\" It further says, \"Within minutes, the fire spread to the flammable liquid storage area, causing 55-gallon drums of flammable hazardous waste to explode and sending fireballs hundreds of feet into the air.\"",
